jamie_support: Customer (AcmeCorp) reports streaming completion cuts off mid-payload when moving from 5G->WiFi roaming. They see a partial JSON object, then SSE connection closes. Billing shows tokens consumed for aborted response and again on reconnect — customer worried about double charge. They provided session id: s-0c9f4a and SDK v0.12.3.

liam_eng: Thanks — can you paste the raw client logs & last 3 lines of server logs for that session? Likely NAT pinhole or client socket teardown. Also which protocol? SSE or websockets?

jamie_support: It's SSE via our JS SDK (browser mobile), sample logs attached (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-10 18:12:43] SSE: open
[2026-03-10 18:12:48] data: {"delta":"Hello\nWorl"
[2026-03-10 18:12:49] error: net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED
[2026-03-10 18:12:49] closed
```

sasha_oncall: ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED points to client OS rebind. On iOS/Android switching radios the socket often gets RST. Server may have buffered partial chunk. We should confirm whether our proxy is forwarding EOF vs RST.

liam_eng: Agreed. Ask customer to repro with `curl -N` from device (or tethered laptop) to confirm proxy behavior. Provide this command:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams?session=s-0c9f4a" -N
```

jamie_support: They tried curl from laptop while tethered — curl shows data then `<3s gap>` then `Connection reset by peer`.

liam_eng: Probable chain: carrier NAT expires, client tries new IP -> kernel issues transforms into `ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED` and app re-establishes new SSE. On our side two things worth confirming:
- heartbeat interval between keepalive packets (client vs proxy)
- whether token rotation during reconnection causes duplicate billing events

sasha_oncall: Workaround for now: advise customer to enable `retry` in SDK (debounces quick reconnects) and switch to `longpoll` fallback for flaky networks. Also suggest bumping client keepalive (if possible) to 15s.

jamie_support: For billing question — customer is worried about double-charge. We bill per token emitted. If a response aborted mid-stream and a reconnect requests remaining tokens, they may be charged twice for overlapping output. We'll need billing team confirmation. @liam any quick mitigation? :pray:

liam_eng: Short-term mitigation: add `idempotency_token` option to streaming call so retries can dedupe on our infra. I'll open an infra issue to explore accept/reject dedupe on session id. Long-term: make token-metering tied to finalization ack from client.

ingest-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2026 to add idempotent streaming token logic. 

jamie_support: OK I'll send repro steps and ask for pcap + SDK debug log. Customer appreciates the retry guidance. Thanks all :thumbsup:
